title: a folder or link at .claude/skills/jitso that is not jitso's is refused without --force
source: intended: docs: B4B5-DESIGN.md `install skill` states (the link: anything else is unmanaged for that path)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-16, B4.3). Nothing is written, not even the real folder.
